from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityChange(BaseModel):
    """The change in equity/profits reported by a single company in its financial statements."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the document")
    equity_metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The name of the specific equity metric line item used in the document (e.g., 'Accumulated Deficit', 'Retained Earnings')")
    change_magnitude: float | None = Field(description="The absolute amount of the change reported")
    change_direction: str | None = Field(description="Whether the metric increased or decreased as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the metric and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equity_changes: list[CompanyEquityChange]
